text:
A benchtop instrument stands on a light grey perforated optical-style table. At left is a white column with a black vertical rail and a white head unit bearing a yellow warning label and screws; a black cable runs from its top right. Below the head, a red-capped tube or nozzle assembly is held in a black bracket, angled downward; its red portion sits above a red-orange body, with no visible liquid inside.

To the right, black anodised linear stages and a green mounting plate support a white-and-silver robotic arm joint that extends from the right edge toward the stage. A thin white cable loops over the green plate. Behind, at upper right, is a white instrument with a red digital display and blue labelled panel.
